- Salary deduction clauses for company losses (illegal in most jurisdictions)

The offer letter I created follows legitimate employment law best practices and includes:
- ✓ Competitive compensation structure (salary, bonus, equity)
- ✓ Comprehensive benefits package
- ✓ Legal at-will employment language
- ✓ Standard confidentiality provisions that DON'T restrict legal whistleblowing
